from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily, fillForward=False).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(101, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = data.Bars

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy] if bars.ContainsKey(self.spy) else None
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl] if bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl) else None

        previous_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

        if spy_bar is not None:
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            else:
                self.previous_spy_sma = None

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        if previous_spy_close is None or previous_spy_sma is None:
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value)

        spy_crossed_above = (
            previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        spy_crossed_below = (
            previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_sell_reason = aapl_rsi > 60.0
        aapl_buy_reason = self.aapl_red_streak >= 1

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
            quantity = self.strategy_a_lot
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -quantity, tag="Strategy A sell")
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            quantity = self.strategy_b_lot
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -quantity, tag="Strategy B sell")
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, tag="Strategy A buy")
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if (
            self.strategy_b_lot == 0
            and aapl_buy_reason
            and float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000.0
        ):
            quantity = int(math.floor(20000.0 / aapl_close))

            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, tag="Strategy B buy")
                self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy] if self.spy in data.Bars else None
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl] if self.aapl in data.Bars else None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            previous_close = self.previous_spy_close
            previous_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
            previous_sma_ready = self.previous_spy_sma_ready

            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)

            current_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady
            current_sma = (
                float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
                if current_sma_ready
                else None
            )

            spy_buy_signal = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma_ready
                and current_sma_ready
                and previous_close <= previous_sma
                and spy_close > current_sma
            )

            spy_sell_signal = (
                previous_close is not None
                and previous_sma_ready
                and current_sma_ready
                and previous_close >= previous_sma
                and spy_close < current_sma
            )

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_sma
            self.previous_spy_sma_ready = current_sma_ready
        else:
            spy_close = None
            spy_buy_signal = False
            spy_sell_signal = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close
        else:
            aapl_close = None

        required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in required_symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        aapl_sell_signal = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60

        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_sell_signal:
            shares = self.strategy_a_shares
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -shares, tag="Strategy A sell")
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and aapl_sell_signal:
            shares = self.strategy_b_shares
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -shares, tag="Strategy B sell")
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_buy_signal:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            shares = int(target_value / spy_close)

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares, tag="Strategy A buy")
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 1:

                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares, tag="Strategy B buy")
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares
